conventions.saturation: clamped to +/-448 before the cast (torch's fp8 cast does not saturate)

description: The SCALE-FREE fp8 storage flavour: eligible weights are clamped to +/-448 and stored as F8_E4M3, everything else keeps BF16, and NO scale tensor exists anywhere. Consumption is diffusers layerwise casting — fp8 bytes resident, bf16 compute — so the dequant is a cast and not a multiply. Transcribed from python-gen-worker `src/gen_worker/convert/writer.py:453` `fp8_cast_eligible`: a float `.weight` of rank 2 OR MORE (conv kernels included, unlike the rank-2-only w8a8 requant), whose module path misses every skip pattern. There is no dim-alignment conjunct and no repeated-block conjunct — this flavour is not feeding a scaled_mm. THE ABSENCE OF SCALES IS THE IDENTITY. `cozy.fp8-rowwise` has the same element type and the same tensor names; a reader that took one for the other would either divide by scales that are not there or fail to divide by scales that are, and both are silent.
name: cozy.fp8-storage
